item_name: Insulin — Insulin injections (number of days insulin injections were received)

lookback_source.quote: Enter in Item N0350A, the number of days during the 7-day look-back period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days) that insulin injections were received.

lookback_notes: The item's own pages state a 7-day look-back period, or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days. Per the document's general convention, a 7-day observation period consists of the ARD plus the 6 previous calendar days (rai-manual-v1.20.1, p. 2-21); that counting method comes from the general convention, not from the N0350 pages.

coding_levels.label: Number of days insulin injections were received
coding_levels.definition: Record the number of days that insulin injections were received during the last 7 days or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days.

source.quote: A. Insulin injections Record the number of days that insulin injections were received during the last 7 days or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days

federal_coding_rules.rule: For subcutaneous insulin pumps, code only the number of days that the resident actually required a subcutaneous injection to restart the pump. (Stated in the Coding Tips and Special Populations section of N0350, which appears after the Coding Instructions for N0350B; the tip is not explicitly limited to a single sub-item.)

federal_coding_rules.rule: Insulin injections are counted in Item N0350 as well as in Item N0300 (Injections).
